name: noni
howto: Fruit can be eaten raw or cooked.

name: ulu
howto: Large fruit eaten and made into poi. Sweet dishes can be made from ulu and niu cream.

name: kalo
howto: Used for Poi production. Poi is made through steaming the corm, mashing it, and adding water.

name: niu
howto: Niu water used as a drink, and flesh eaten raw or with poi

name: kō
howto: Normally a condiment, in times of famine a 'life saver'
